# Powerhouse Holdings

> Powerhouse Holdings, LLC is a private American holding company. It sells nothing itself; it builds, owns, and operates the companies that do.

## The companies

- [Powerhouse Digital](https://powerhousedigital.net/): wholly owned. Custom, secure websites with whatever functionality a business needs, plus marketing and brand design, for businesses of every type and size.
- [Powerhouse Consulting](https://powerhouseholdings.us/companies.html#consulting): wholly owned. General business consultants with expertise in logistics, systems, vertical integration, and developing markets.
- Viresco Ventures: a venture holding company for early-stage, longer-horizon ventures.
